changes: Name days now reach the calendar link you subscribe to. Birthdays and anniversaries have been going out for a while; name days quietly weren't, so the day showed up in Teluva and nowhere else.
Nothing to redo — links you've already shared pick them up on their next refresh.
A movable celebration goes out only for the years it's actually been worked out, never as a repeating rule. A lunar date guessed a year ahead would land on the wrong day.
A day still waiting for your yes stays here. Teluva won't put a suggestion on somebody else's phone.
